errorCodes.meaning: The network has no entry for the issuer, or none in a state that can be repudiated (`listed`, `acknowledged` or `suspended`).

The repudiation is not a `repudiates/1` statement issued by the requester about this network, does not verify, or names neither the entry's listing nor — for a member — its grant. A member that names its listing is refused too: a member departs by naming the grant. `details.message` says which.

Credential.description: A DTG credential (W3C VC 2.0, JSON) exactly as signed. Verified by the party relying on it, never by its shape here: it is an open object so a binding cannot narrow away a member the proof covers.

Description.description: What the listed party is, for the directory.

EntryKind.description: What the entry lists (VTI-VTN-031): a community, whose entries are its members, or a network, whose entries are further listings. A listing credential carries the same fact as `nodeType` `VTC` or `VTN`.

EntryProfile.description: What the directory shows about an entry, set by the network's administrators.

EntryState.description: `listed`: the network lists the party and the party has not answered; this is never membership (VTI-VTN-013). `acknowledged`: the party acknowledged the network's grant; it is a member. `repudiated`: the party rejected the listing. `suspended`: the network suspended the membership; reversible. `removed`: the network ended the entry. `departed`: the party left, by repudiating the grant.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

IndexEntry.description: An entry as the network publishes it, with the credentials a verifier needs.

acknowledged.description: Whether the party acknowledged: true only for a member. Every published entry states it (VTI-VTN-013).

Response.description: The party's entry as it now stands, with its repudiation.
Response.title: VTN Membership — Repudiate — response payload

schema.description: A listed party's repudiation of its listing, or a member's repudiation of its grant. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

repudiation.description: The party's `repudiates/1` statement, issued by the requester about the network, whose `credentialSubject.object.digestMultibase` names the listing or the grant.
